latestEmail.subject: Attempt 3 unlock before this weekend
latestEmail.body:
Hi,

I was told by my mentor that you are my new instructor for C999. I still cannot believe I failed my second attempt on Nov 12. If you look at my coaching report, the bar was literally touching the line for SQL queries and DDL/DML.

Please just send me whatever requirements I need to check off so I can take the test this weekend. My term ends December 31st and I have to get this class behind me before the holidays.

Thanks,
Alex

crmNotes.author: R. Miller (Previous CI)
crmNotes.title: OA Attempt 1 Review & Attempt 2 Study Plan Sent
crmNotes.body: Reviewed Attempt 1 coaching report with Alex (missed cut score by a wide margin). Student admitted they stopped reading after Chapter 2, skimmed Chapter 3, and skipped all the zyBooks labs because they passed the Pre-Assessment on their 4th try and assumed the OA would have the same questions. Emailed Attempt 2 Study Plan below.

attachment.heading: Attached Email — OA Attempt 2 Study Plan (Sent Mar 15, 2026)
attachment.content:
Hi Alex,
To get approved for your second attempt in C999, please complete the following steps:
1. Read Chapter 3 in zyBooks.
2. Complete the Normalization Activity worksheet.
3. Score 90% or higher on the End-of-Chapter Quizzes and email me screenshots of your scores.

Once you email me the quiz screenshots, we will do a quick call to unlock Attempt 2.

crmNotes.author: Alex M.
crmNotes.title: Quiz Screenshots Attached — Requesting Attempt 2 Unlock
crmNotes.body: Hi Instructor Miller, I attached screenshots showing 90%+ on all five chapter quizzes. I have a work trip coming up this weekend so I need to take my OA before Friday. Please unlock Attempt 2.

crmNotes.author: R. Miller (Previous CI)
crmNotes.title: OA Attempt 2 Unlock Call & Approval
crmNotes.body: Completed 15-minute Attempt 2 review call. Student was very rushed on the phone and pushing hard to test before leaving for a work trip. Verified the 90% quiz screenshots from their email. Asked Alex to explain the difference between a Primary Key and a Foreign Key. They struggled at first and went silent for a bit, but eventually found the definition in their notes and read it back accurately. Approved OA Attempt 2.

crmNotes.author: D. Brooks (Program Mentor)
crmNotes.title: Student Requested Course Instructor Change
crmNotes.body: Spoke with Alex after their Nov 12 OA Attempt 2 failure. Alex was very frustrated and requested a new Course Instructor for C999, sharing that they felt they didn't align with their current CI's style, felt rushed on their last unlock call, and still weren't sure what they actually got wrong on the test. Submitted CI reassignment request to the C999 Manager.
